achievements.name: Point of Arrival
achievements.detail: Clear the opening area and reach the first world map.

achievements.name: Copied Power
achievements.detail: Inhale an enemy and swallow it to gain its copy ability.

achievements.name: Mouthful Mode
achievements.detail: Swallow a huge object and cross part of a stage while it fills your mouth.

achievements.name: Dee Rescue
achievements.detail: Free a caged Waddle Dee so it can return to town.

achievements.name: Natural Plains
achievements.detail: Clear every stage in the first region.

achievements.name: Treasure Road
achievements.detail: Finish a Treasure Road challenge stage.

achievements.name: Mission Clear
achievements.detail: Complete one of the mission goals listed for a stage.

achievements.name: Evolved Ability
achievements.detail: Upgrade a copy ability at the weapons shop in town.

achievements.name: Gotcha Figure
achievements.detail: Spend coins at a capsule machine and collect a figure.

achievements.name: Colosseum Cup
achievements.detail: Win a cup in the town colosseum.

achievements.name: Story Clear
achievements.detail: Clear the last stage of the main story.

achievements.name: Final Challenge
achievements.detail: Finish the last postgame challenge that opens after the story is over.
